title: Rampagent
tagline: Run agents like a unicorn team. Rampagents gives you x402 observability, spend control and structure
description:
Rampagents brings the “10 person, billion dollar company” vision into reality. Today, AI agents can execute tasks, but they can’t reliably orchestrate, budget, delegate, or manage work the way large organizations do. We built Rampagents to fill that gap.

Rampagents combines Coinbase’s x402 framework on Base and Polygon with Filecoin’s decentralized storage stack to create a full platform for swarm-level observability, budget control, and organizational structure. Using smart wallets, each agent receives a defined budget and can autonomously “hire” subagents, delegate tasks, and pay for tools or API calls on its own.

All execution metadata is stored on Filecoin through the Synapse SDK, giving long-term visibility into performance: which x402 endpoints waste money, which ones provide high-value outputs, and how agent swarms behave over time.
how_its_made:
We built Rampagents by combining Coinbase’s x402 framework, smart wallets on Base and Polygon, and Filecoin’s Synapse SDK into a unified agent-orchestration stack. Agents are spun up through x402, assigned on-chain budgets, and can recursively hire subagents and pay for tools using chain-native spend controls.

Our backend tracks every tool call, cost, and output through a custom tracing pipeline, then stores the metadata on Filecoin for immutable, long-term observability. This lets us analyze which endpoints are cost-efficient and which ones waste budget. The dashboard visualizes swarm structure, spending, and performance in real time.
